name: Sparse Voxel Octree (Dynamic, Origin-Centered)
definition: A sparse voxel octree implementation where voxel widths are powers of 2, positions are integer multiples of their widths (ensuring alignment to widths), the tree is always centered at (0,0,0), and the tree expands dynamically on insert.
summary: A dynamic, origin-centered sparse voxel octree where voxel widths are powers of two and positions are integer multiples, differing from static SVOs by growing only when necessary and from general octrees by enforcing strict origin-centered coordinates.
